sentence: This project develops a gene therapy vector to treat Sanfilippo Syndrome Type C, a fatal neurodegenerative disorder of childhood.
This project studies how genetic mutations and immune changes relate to relapse in patients treated after a stem cell transplant.
This project tries to find out how measles virus spreads from cell to cell in airway cells.
This project studies how focal seizures in the hippocampus impair the function of the cerebral cortex in temporal lobe epilepsy.
This project studies how behavioral activation psychotherapy changes symptoms and neural circuits over the course of therapy for adolescent depression.
This project studies how a protein regulates energy metabolism during human brain development.
This project builds improved T cells that target pathogenic B cells in pemphigus vulgaris and myasthenia gravis.
This project uses machine learning and predictive analytics on clinical cohorts to study care strategies for HIV control.
This project tries to find which genes control lipids and metabolites that Mycobacterium tuberculosis needs for infection, transmission and drug resistance.
This project tries to find genetic drivers that differ between males and females in Alzheimer's disease brain damage and cognitive impairment.
This project tests a treatment for neuroblastoma, a pediatric tumor, that aims to restore how the tumor responds to therapy.
This project studies how an intrinsically disordered region of the primary sigma-factor helps Mycobacterium tuberculosis control transcription and resist antibiotic.
This project tries to find which immune ligands drive a macrophage signal that affects anti-tumor immunity in clear cell cancers.
This project studies how a protein made outside the thymus, and cells that make it, affect tumor growth and immune responses.
This project studies how an enzyme and a prostaglandin D2 receptor weaken immune defenses in aged mice with lung metastases.
This project studies how phosphatidic acid helps the liver repair itself after injury from acetaminophen overdose.
This project studies how a protein on leukemia-associated macrophages affects the way leukemia develops.
This project studies how macula densa cells affect immune cells in the normal and diseased kidney.
This project studies how gene regulation lets the neural crest of the head and neck form tissues that lower body parts cannot form.
This project studies how Natural Killer cells shape the immune response to cancer in the tumor microenvironment.
